component.name: TruthBeacon
component.summary: Desktop Identity Ground-Truth & Impersonation Prevention Console

description.p: TruthBeacon is an operator-focused desktop security console designed for Discord community stewardship. It monitors server member events in real-time, detecting homoglyphic spoofing, authoritative affix impersonation, and cloned avatars against verified identity benchmarks before malicious actors can defraud community members.

ul.li: Sub-50ms deterministic multi-script homoglyph evaluation (Cyrillic, Greek, Mathematical).
Perceptual discrete cosine transform (DCT) visual hash matching for avatar clones.
Cryptographic snowflake age analysis and automated compound threat adjudication.
Zero-telemetry architecture with local data sovereignty and encrypted OS Keychain credential storage.

description.p: Initial release of TruthBeacon with real-time Discord Gateway v10 monitoring and multi-tiered threat adjudication.
